_comment: Named mod sets for `jbmod <Mod> compat <set>`: packageIds loaded next to the mod under test. A mod is taken from the game's Mods folder or the Workshop folder, else from the Rimling compat cache (~/Library/Caches/RimlingModCompat) as a temporary _jb_c<slot>_<n> symlink. packageIds of third-party mods are not verified here; a missing one stops the run with MISSING.
